concept: A volatile stock chart rendered as a jagged mountain range, with sharp peaks and plummeting valleys, the line tracing upward and downward erratically. The silhouette of a bull and bear locked in struggle at the base. Dark storm clouds gather overhead, electric bolts cutting through. The color scheme shifts abruptly between warm and cold tones to reflect the market whiplash. Style: bold geometric shapes, high contrast, digital/modernist.
explanation: Today's headlines pit optimism against dread: AI stocks soaring while economies fracture (Paraguay's banking collapse, Spanish rail fraud), violence escalates (Kenya's cult murders, European bomb threats), and institutional confidence erodes (Cornell's no-confidence vote, judicial blocks on major projects). The contradictory market movements—investors fleeing tech over political fears, then buying AI stocks anyway—epitomize the emotional chaos: simultaneous greed, anxiety, and loss of control. The chart itself becomes a metaphor for instability.

headlines.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
headlines.summary: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

headlines.title: Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
headlines.summary: The buzz about the presidential election is already under way - here's what we learned this week.

headlines.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
headlines.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
